title: NPDev theme (npdev-theme.v1)
description: A theme is DATA, never CSS. Every value is a 6-digit hex colour, a font-family list from a safe character set, a small integer or an enum, so a theme file from anywhere (an AI, a catalogue, a stranger) cannot inject CSS, load a remote resource or run code. The same file styles the NPDev Manager and every generated app. Contrast is checked by the theme engine, not by this schema.

id.description: Stable identifier, also the file name (<id>.json). Built-in ids: npdev-dark, npdev-light, retro, synth, farm, warm, windows, high-contrast, npdev-default.

names.description: Optional translated display names keyed by BCP-47 language (pt, es, ...).

license.description: SPDX id for catalogue themes, e.g. CC0-1.0 or MIT.

colorScheme.description: Which scheme `colors` is. Sets CSS color-scheme so scrollbars and native controls match.

basedOn.description: Inherit every token from this theme id, then override. Lets an AI 'make a variation' by changing three colours. Chains are allowed up to depth 3; cycles are an error.

darkColors.description: Optional. When present the theme supports light/dark/system switching: `colors` is the light set and `darkColors` the dark one (colorScheme must then be light).

elevation.description: A named shadow recipe the engine expands; never a raw box-shadow string.

fontList.description: A CSS font-family list using fonts already on the machine. No url(), no @font-face, no semicolons or braces -- the character set makes those impossible.

borderStrong.description: Input and control outlines (>= 3:1 on bg and surface).

text.description: Body text (>= 4.5:1 on bg, surface, surfaceRaised).

accent.description: Links, active tab, primary button fill (>= 4.5:1 on bg and surface).

onAccent.description: Text on an accent fill (>= 4.5:1 on accent).
